heading: What's the offer?
subtitle: Tell creators what makes your listing special and what perks they'll get.

amenities.label: Property amenities
amenities.desc: Search and select what your property offers. These appear on your listing page.
amenities.searchPlaceholder: Search amenities (e.g., WiFi, pool, hot tub)

addOns.label: Add-ons
addOns.desc: Optional extras you can include to sweeten the offer.

affiliate.codeDesc: Paste your own affiliate code or link from your booking platform (e.g., Airbnb, VRBO, direct site).
affiliate.percentDesc: What percentage commission will the creator earn from your affiliate link?
affiliate.trackingNote: Collabnb does not currently track affiliate clicks. Code-honoring is on the host. Real tracking coming in a future update.

vibeTags.label: Vibe tags (optional)
vibeTags.desc: Add a few words that describe the vibe (Cozy, Luxury, Adventure, etc.)

maxOffers.label: How many times do you want to offer this collab?
maxOffers.desc: Set a max number of confirmed collabs for this listing. Once reached, the listing auto-pauses.
